entities.summary: Duane Ferrell is an American retired professional basketball player. He played 11 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Atlanta Hawks, Indiana Pacers and Golden State Warriors. He played college basketball for the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets, twice earning All-Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) honors.
